installCommand: node -e "if (require('fs').existsSync('build/index.html')) { console.log('Prebuilt docs found, skipping install'); } else { require('child_process').execSync('npm install', {stdio: 'inherit'}); }"
buildCommand: node -e "if (require('fs').existsSync('build/index.html')) { console.log('Prebuilt docs found, skipping remote build'); } else { require('child_process').execSync('docusaurus build', {stdio: 'inherit'}); }"
